title: Collapse Commands to a single index page

sections.what: Replace the 86 per-verb `docs/virtualWorld/Commands/*.md` pages with a single **Commands index** - every verb and its aliases, grouped, linking each verb to the feature page and section that owns it.
sections.why: Verbs are *mechanics*, so they belong on their feature page (`Movement` owns `go`/`dash`/`climb`/`jump`/`crawl`, `Combat` owns `attack`). 86 thin pages duplicate the feature pages at the wrong granularity. The index is a clean lookup convenience; the substance lives on the feature page.
sections.how: Write `Commands.md`: verb, aliases, status, and which feature/section documents it. Move any verb detail onto the owning feature page. Delete the 86 pages and retarget inbound links (`[[examine]]`, `[[light]]`, `[[fumble around]]` point at `Features/examine`, `Features/light`, and the search/listen pages).
sections.verify:
1. `python tools/doc_links.py --check`.
   - expected: no new broken links after deletion.
   - observed: TODO
2. Look up `go` from the index.
   - expected: lands on the Movement page section.
   - observed: TODO

acceptance.text: one Commands index page lists every verb + aliases
verb detail lives on the owning feature page
the 86 pages are deleted and no link dangles
